add_library(qpOASES SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
set_target_properties(
  qpOASES
  PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/libqpOASES.so.3.2
             INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

install(FILES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/libqpOASES.so.3.2 DESTINATION lib)
